song.title: Ты искупил мир от греха
song.lyrics:
[V1] Father we ask that You would come Shine Your light and love on us Renew our dry and weary hearts With Your new hope
[V2] We come to offer You our lives And worship You as Lord and King Reveal Your power among the lost Save this nation
[C1] Glory and honor to Jesus All of the earth and nations Lift up the name of Jesus Give Him the glory forever Glory and honor to Jesus All of the earth, and nations Lift up the name of Jesus Give Him the glory forevermore
